principle: Subject tags are a fine-grained TERM-level classification for the Encyclopedia (glossary coverage + search disambiguation) — distinct from collections-registry.json's subjectAreas[], which classifies whole codex COLLECTIONS at a coarser grain (e.g. 'civil-commercial' covers หนี้/ทรัพย์/ละเมิด/นิติกรรม/มรดก/ครอบครัว/องค์กรธุรกิจ all at once and cannot answer 'which of these is this term in'). This registry does not replace subjectAreas[] and is not itself a Concept identity — it is classification metadata a concept may carry (subjectTags[]) so the Encyclopedia can show 'this term belongs to หนี้ / ละเมิด / ...' at a glance. A concept may legitimately carry more than one tag; a tag must only be assigned where the concept's own authored content or relatedConcepts[] actually supports it, never merely because a term appeared in a pasted glossary list.
